title: Magazine p. 54: Newspaper-published Apollo 11 "two UFOs" photo; Apollo-12 "moon pigeons"
description: Photocopied magazine page of article text with a small, faint photograph (numbered 25) at top, captioned "Published newspaper story on UFOs captions this photo: 'These two UFOs were photographed on July 19, 1969—the day before Apollo's historic moon landing—during Buzz Aldrin's scheduled lunar photo session. Note the similarity to the shot snapped three years earlier during Gemini-12.'" The text discusses Saga magazine accounts of Apollo-12 UFOs and a Lockheed report, "Unidentified Visual Phenomena Associated with Space Flight" (NAS 9-5191), on the "moon pigeons."
